target.claim: Initialize explicit local derivative and one-plaquette exceptional-event bounds for the exact SU(2) heat-kernel action.

conventions.claim: SU(2) is the unit S3 with Haar probability and class angle theta in [0,pi].
The generator is one half the Laplace-Beltrami operator and the character exponent is exp(-n(n+2)t/2).

proved.claim: Character and Poisson-image heat-kernel representations agree.
Paired image corrections have explicit Q0--Q3 derivative and omitted-tail bounds.
The local scaled Hessian remainder is bounded explicitly.
The local scaled Euclidean third derivative is bounded explicitly.
Curvature-chart derivative constants propagate by explicit chain-rule formulas.
The event theta(U_p)>=rho is gauge invariant.
The one-plaquette exceptional probability has a character-series enclosure with analytic tail.

numerical.claim: Character/image ratios agree at the calibration points.
At t_max=0.2 and rho=1 the Hessian and third budgets are approximately 0.0824566 and 0.149094.
Tail probabilities are evaluated with analytic truncation and explicit floating roundoff allowances.

open_frontier.claim: Explicit full 2^4 transported plaquette-log, slice, retained/fiber projection, and overlap constants.
Dependent gauge-invariant bad-block polymer and topological-sector activity.
Initialization of all Stage 06 components for generated localized interactions.
Uniform multistep closure and nonperturbative retained-base crossover.
Nontrivial OS continuum Yang-Mills theory and Hamiltonian mass gap.

forbidden_inferences: A one-plaquette radial certificate is not a 216-plaquette block theorem.
An analytic character tail is not a dependent polymer estimate.
Small heat time is not a generated infrared mass scale.
A local logarithmic chart does not cover the cut locus or all gauge orbits.
Explicit local constants do not imply cutoff-uniform RG iteration.
